title: story-progress
description: The live progress record a Story's handoff and close rewrite at every step or phase change (Story #5553), at <tempRoot>/orchestration/story-progress-<id>.json. It exists because push, PR, review, auto-merge and the merge wait leave nothing on disk until the terminal envelope. Advisory only: nothing in Mandrel reads it to decide anything, every write is best effort, and each write is atomic (a <file>.tmp sibling renamed over the target).

stage.description: handoff — the worker's story-handoff.js run; close — single-story-close.js.

phase.description: For close, the phase name close passes to setPhase (the phaseDurations keys). For handoff, the step name: preflight, base-merge, credited-run, seat, push, review.

stageStartedAt.description: When this handoff or close run started; fixed for the run.

phaseStartedAt.description: When the current phase started; resets on each phase change.

prNumber.description: The Story PR's number from the moment close parses it; null before then and throughout handoff.
